criterion.statement: a package counts as an installable plugin/bundle package when its own package.json declares dsh.bundle.patch, or dsh.client, or dsh.profile.bundles; a name inside a profile manifest dsh.profile.bundles counts as installed-as-a-layer for that profile

packages/boot/app-boot/tests/profile.spec.ts:283 (dsh.profile.bundles resolves to patch layers in order)
criterion.excluded: transitive dependencies in node_modules/.pnpm (the store) and nested node_modules of a package are not separate packages of a profile; only the top level and @scope level of a node_modules directory are enumerated
